translation: Isumaan (Golyaat) dhaabbatee, warra Isa'elii (barree) — qajeelchaan: warra Isa'elii — (barree) hime: Maaltu (barree) — qajeelchaan: Maaltu — (barree) Maaltu faana isaa baafatte (barree) — (barree) — qajeelchaan: Maaltu faana isaa baafatte gara waraanaa baatanii (barree) — (barree) miti — qajeelchaan: Maaltu faana isaa baafatte gara waraanaa (barree) akkasumas (barree) — (barree) dhaabbataadhaan qajeelchaan: ani Filisti dha, isin immoo gabboota Saawuli tani — qajeelchaan: isin immoo gabboota Saawuli tani — filadhaa (barree) duratti akka (barree) qajeelchaan: namtokko isinii filadhaa, gara kiyya (barree) — akka bu'u haa (barree) — qajeelchaan: gara kiyya akka bu'u haa (barree) — isitti (barree) akkasumas qajeelchaan: gara kiyya bu'aa.
